reference_frame.definition: At each governed interval, choose the common rigid angular velocity Omega_g that minimizes the surface-area-weighted integral over the spherical surface of |v(r)-Omega_g cross r|^2, then express all plate velocities relative to Omega_g. This removes the least-squares common rigid-body gauge component; it does not assert that an area-weighted mean of plate angular-velocity vectors is zero. Relative plate rotations are unchanged, and no mantle-fixed frame or torque balance is asserted.
reference_frame.earth_transfer_limit: Earth NNR is a convention with physical interpretations contested; for R6 it is adopted only to remove arbitrary whole-planet spin, not as a geophysical observation.

earth_prior.qualifier: Published global Mesozoic-Cenozoic aggregate continental RMS statistics; not a per-plate distribution or a selected R6 speed.
earth_prior.conditional_plate_speed_context: In analyzed Earth reconstructions, plates with >50% continental area reach approximately 10 cm/yr maximum RMS; the relationship also depends on subducting perimeter, cratonic fraction, reference frame, and reconstruction uncertainty.

initial_motion.units: angular velocity rad/year (canonical) with derived surface speed m/year; Earth comparison statistics cm/year
initial_motion.direction_selection: NOT_BOUND; cannot draw independent directions until vector topology, adjacency and boundary semantics are bound.
initial_motion.uncertainty: MODEL_UNCERTAINTY; retain source range/statistics without inventing a probability distribution.
initial_motion.remaining_gap: A global RMS prior cannot specify plate-specific angular vectors, relative motion, or causal forcing for this synthetic t0.

motion_segment_validity.rule: Hybrid validity: a segment ends at the earliest governed hard event, topology/state transition, motion-law validity limit, or displacement/error bound. No fixed global Myr segment is imposed.
motion_segment_validity.evidence: Noise-reduced Earth ridge reconstructions find plate-motion changes on timescales no shorter than a few million years; this is a resolution/noise caution, not a universal minimum or maximum R6 segment length.
motion_segment_validity.remaining_gap: No R6 law-specific persistence or numeric displacement/error tolerance.

motion_change_law.candidate_structure: Piecewise constant finite-rotation stage within a declared valid segment; segment renewal only under a causal, event/driver-conditioned rule with bounded changes and memory.
motion_change_law.unbound: The rule choosing next angular velocity, magnitude/direction correlation, acceleration bound, event response and uncertainty.
motion_change_law.rejected: Independent per-plate random vectors, unconstrained random walk, and using plate solver defaults as physical law.

t0_vector_partition.method_contract: Convert each supported 1-degree plate_id cell to its exact spherical cell polygon and union by plate ID; close/check spherical topology; retain original raster cell membership and parent cell IDs on each arc/face; encode support as COARSE_SUPPORT_ON_FINE_GRID and boundary uncertainty as no finer than source-cell support. No smoothing, snapping, interpolation, sub-cell inference, or support upgrade.
t0_vector_partition.materialization: NOT_PERFORMED; separate implementation and validation step required before use.
t0_vector_partition.master_geometry_claim: No claim that pixel-edge polygons are true geological plate boundaries.

weak_zones.minimum_representation: three-valued WEAK_ZONE_SUPPORT={SUPPORTED_WEAK, SUPPORTED_NOT_WEAK, UNKNOWN}; do not assign numeric strength until calibrated rheological model exists.
weak_zones.t0_status: UNKNOWN; province/suture/orogenic design classes do not authorize mechanical weakness.
weak_zones.behavior: UNKNOWN weakness makes rift eligibility UNKNOWN; no rift may be triggered from UNKNOWN.
weak_zones.evidence_limit: Literature supports inherited structures influencing localization, but not one transferable scalar/class threshold for an invented global synthetic plate mosaic.

extensional_forcing.definition: At an authorized shared boundary segment, let n_AB be the local unit normal directed from plate A into plate B and v_A,v_B be their tangent-plane velocities at that segment. Opening extension rate e=max(0,(v_B-v_A) dot n_AB).
extensional_forcing.support: Boundary-segment support only; not a cell-wide score. Temporal support is the validity interval of the input kinematic segment.
extensional_forcing.current_value: NOT_COMPUTABLE; neither input is presently bound/materialized.
extensional_forcing.interpretation: Kinematic opening proxy, not stress, strain, heat, or proof of rift eligibility.

rift_eligibility.predicate_structure: Eligibility requires supported inherited weakness AND supported positive boundary-normal extension under a bound persistence/measurement criterion. Evaluate with three-valued logic: known false input can make predicate INELIGIBLE; all required true inputs make ELIGIBLE; otherwise UNKNOWN.
rift_eligibility.threshold: UNBOUND; e>0 is not by itself a scientifically calibrated rift threshold.
rift_eligibility.evidence: Rift initiation exploits inherited weaknesses and competing drivers/resistance; successful versus failed rifting remains process-dependent and debated.

rift_initiation.candidate_structure: Initiation after eligible extension accumulates in time/strain under a governed threshold or driver-conditioned hazard; any stochastic component requires an authorized distribution and seed lineage.
rift_initiation.parameters: No universal transferable accumulated-extension, strain, duration, or hazard threshold established for R6.
rift_initiation.not_authorized: No random timestamp; no event from UNKNOWN eligibility.

required_before_event: minimum resolved feature scale tied to source support/solver
rift_split_realization.reason: Rift eligibility is unknown, so no evidence proves the split law can be deferred; equally, no split law can be bound by transferring local Earth rift cases to global R6.

initial_event_census.purpose: Deterministic support-aware classification of rift initiation, split and any applicable convergence/contact as INELIGIBLE, ELIGIBLE, UNKNOWN, or ACTIVE; census emits no events.
initial_event_census.current_result: NOT_EXECUTABLE; no event or rift is asserted.

numerical_step_acceptance.policy_structure: Choose the largest trial interval satisfying angular/displacement bounds, solver error criteria, topology validity, and event-bracketing/localization; reject and subdivide if any criterion fails. Stop at the earliest event/state/law boundary.
numerical_step_acceptance.numeric_limits: UNBOUND; values must be tied to selected solver precision, source-support scale, law timescales and restart-equivalence tests.
numerical_step_acceptance.earth_resolution_context: Published reconstructions commonly resolve stages at multi-Myr scales; observations do not determine numerical error tolerances for R6.

uncertainty_and_canonical_realization.policy: Use bounded intervals where literature supports bounds; retain UNKNOWN where it does not; do not invent Gaussian or uniform distributions. A canonical realization must be precommitted and outcome-blind. Seeded sampling is permitted only after the joint prior, constraints, seed lineage and selection rule are authorized.
uncertainty_and_canonical_realization.canonical_motion_realization: NOT_BOUND; no values drawn or selected.
uncertainty_and_canonical_realization.ensemble: NOT_RUN; do not vary all parameters indiscriminately.

requirements.remaining_gap: Prior is aggregate plausibility only; per-plate vectors and canonical selection missing.
